title: Input logic levels
description: With SW1 open, measure BUTTON at U10 output. Pass if ≥ 2.0 V (logic HIGH). Press and hold SW1; pass if ≤ 0.4 V (logic LOW).

title: Debounce effectiveness
description: Connect an oscilloscope to U10 output and press SW1 rapidly several times. Pass if no more than one LOW transition per press is visible at U10 output.

title: ESD protection present
description: Verify D7 is fitted and oriented correctly (cathode toward input node, anode toward GNDREF path). Visual inspection; pass if D7 marking matches silkscreen.

title: Boot-state pull-down
description: Power the board with no firmware running. Measure BUTTON; pass if LOW (≤ 0.4 V). Note: this is the current expected behaviour but is flagged for review in V1.3.

title: Reverse polarity
description: Apply −12 V to NET-S. Pass if VSC remains at 0 V and no components become warm.

title: Normal operation
description: Apply 12 V; measure VSC. Pass if VSC ≈ 11.5 V.

title: OVP trip
description: Slowly raise supply voltage. Pass if VSC drops to 0 V between 17.5 V and 19.5 V with no oscillation at the threshold (verified at 18.6 V on prototypes).

title: OVP hysteresis
description: After trip, slowly reduce supply voltage. Pass if VSC recovers cleanly at a voltage measurably below the trip point.

title: PTC fuse
description: Short VSC briefly. Pass if F1 trips and the board powers up again without intervention after the fault clears.

title: Bleed resistor
description: Remove supply; measure VSC discharge time. Pass if VSC reaches < 1 V in approximately 4.4 s (R42 × 44 µF).

title: EMI filter ripple
description: Scope VSC with a 65 mA load. Pass if supply ripple is below the LMR51610 VIN ripple tolerance.

title: Filter capacitance at bias
description: Measure C33, C36, C37, C39 at 12 V DC bias. Record actual values and compare against derated filter corner frequency calculations.

title: Surge
description: Apply an ISO 7637-2 Pulse 5b transient (or bench equivalent) to NET-S. Pass if VSC remains stable and all components survive.

title: F1 thermal proximity to D11
description: Run an IEC 61000-4-5 surge sequence and confirm F1 body temperature stays below 70 °C post-surge.

title: L2 cold-start inrush
description: Confirm peak current through L2 at power-on stays below the 2.6 A saturation rating.

title: Bus idle — recessive state
description: With TWAI_EN LOW, measure CANH and CANL at J2. Pass if both sit at approximately 2.5 V.

title: Transceiver enable
description: Assert TWAI_EN HIGH. Pass if U5 enters normal mode with no bus disturbance visible on a scope.

title: TXD default
description: Before TWAI is initialised, measure TXD at U5 pin 1. Pass if HIGH (R15 holding recessive).

title: TWAI loopback
description: Configure the TWAI peripheral in self-test / loopback mode and transmit a frame. Pass if received without error.

title: Receive on live network
description: Connect to an NMEA 2000 network, capture traffic with a CAN analyser. Pass if frames are received at 250 kbps with no error frames.

title: Transmit on live network
description: Send a test PGN. Pass if the frame appears on the network and is acknowledged by another node.

title: Bus fault survivability
description: Apply a brief over-voltage to CANH / CANL at J2. Pass if U9 clamps and U5 survives. The 4 V clamp-vs-spec margin must be characterised before any production run.

title: VCC rail under Wi-Fi TX
description: Probe at U3 pad 2 during a sustained 802.11b TX burst. Pass if the rail stays within ±3 % of 3.30 V with no individual dip below 3.10 V.

title: EN release timing
description: Trigger on VCC rising; capture ESP_EN. Pass if ESP_EN crosses 2.48 V ≥ 10 ms after VCC reaches 3.0 V.

title: I2C rise time
description: Capture SDA / SCL transitions during normal Standard-mode (100 kHz) operation. Record 30 %-to-70 % t<sub>r</sub> and infer C<sub>bus</sub>. Pass if t<sub>r</sub> ≤ 1000 ns.

title: C<sub>bus</sub> measurement
description: Measure SCL / SDA rise time at 400 kHz. Pass if t<sub>r</sub> ≤ 300 ns. If C<sub>bus</sub> exceeds 35 pF (the threshold for 400 kHz with 10 kΩ pull-ups), reduce R3 / R4 to 4.7 kΩ before enabling Fast mode (tracked as a V1.3 backlog item).

title: Nominal supply
description: Apply 12 V to J3 pin 1 with pin 2 to GND. Pass if VST = 12.0 ± 0.5 V.

title: Dropout
description: Apply 9 V to J3 pin 1. Pass if VST ≈ 8.1 V (dropout) and ST_RX still responds to bus signal with LED current ≥ 2.9 mA.

title: Top of range
description: Apply 16 V to J3 pin 1. Pass if VST regulates at 12.0 ± 0.5 V and U14 junction ΔT < 2 °C.

title: Reverse polarity
description: Apply −12 V on pin 1, GND on pin 2. Pass if VST = 0 V and no component failure.

title: Swapped pins
description: Apply 12 V with pin 1 and pin 2 swapped. Pass if VST = 0 V and no component failure.

title: Bus idle
description: Pass if ST_RX ≈ VCC (≥ 2.9 V).

title: Bus pulled low
description: Pull J3 pin 3 to GND via 1 kΩ. Pass if ST_RX ≤ 0.4 V.

title: 4800 baud framing
description: Apply 4800 baud test pattern on J3 pin 3. Pass if framing is captured cleanly on UART RX with no framing errors.

title: 38400 baud framing
description: Apply NMEA 0183 HS pattern at 38400 baud. Pass if framing is captured cleanly.

title: NMEA 0183 listener load
description: Measure input current at J3 pin 3 = 2.0 V. Pass if ≤ 2.0 mA.

title: Dropout LED current
description: Measure VST and I_LED at V_bus = 9 V. Pass if I_LED ≥ 2.0 mA and no missed transitions.

title: Default-disabled
description: Assert ST_EN HIGH (or leave undriven), measure ST_SIG. Pass if ST_SIG = VST (≈ 12 V via R33).

title: Enable, idle
description: Assert ST_EN LOW, ST_TX HIGH. Pass if ST_SIG = VST and Q6 not conducting.

title: Enable, asserted
description: Assert ST_EN LOW, ST_TX LOW. Pass if ST_SIG < 50 mV.

title: Rise time at 4800 baud
description: Toggle ST_TX at 4800 baud and scope the rising edge at ST_SIG. Pass if edge reaches ≥ 80 % of VST within 50 µs.

title: Rise time at 9600 baud
description: Toggle ST_TX at 9600 baud after the C47 rework. Pass if edge reaches ≥ 80 % of VST within 30 µs.

title: D8 static current at 16 V
description: Measure D8 zener leakage and continuous dissipation at V_bus = 16 V. Pass if dissipation ≤ 200 mW.

title: Surge survivability
description: Apply 58 V transient on ST_SIG (clamped by upstream TVS). Pass if no gate-driver or Q6 damage.

title: Power-good indication
description: Apply VCC with no firmware running. Pass if red illuminates immediately and green and blue remain off.

title: Red off
description: Run firmware that asserts LED_RED HIGH. Pass if red extinguishes completely.

title: Green on / off
description: Drive LED_GRN LOW; pass if green illuminates. Drive HIGH; pass if green extinguishes.

title: Blue on / off
description: Drive LED_BLU LOW; pass if blue illuminates. Drive HIGH; pass if blue extinguishes.

title: Brightness balance
description: Illuminate each channel in turn at the corrected resistor values. Measure Vf across each LED die and record actual operating current. Assess perceived brightness; pass if no channel appears more than 2× brighter than the others.

title: Fail-safe states
description: Cycle power several times. Pass if red always illuminates before firmware asserts control and green / blue never flicker on during boot.

title: I2C device detection
description: Scan the I2C bus. U1 must respond at address 0x6A. Pass if the `WHO_AM_I` register (0x0F) returns `0x6A`.

title: Register round-trip
description: Write a known value to a writable register (e.g. CTRL1_XL at 0x10) and read it back. Pass if the read value matches.

title: Live data output
description: Configure accelerometer and gyroscope at 52 Hz, read 10 consecutive samples. Pass if all six axes produce non-zero readings, with the accelerometer Z axis showing approximately ±1 g at rest.

title: VDD supply ripple
description: Measure VDD at U1 pin 8 with a 100 MHz oscilloscope under normal I2C polling load. Pass if ripple is below 50 mV peak-to-peak.

title: Zero-g and zero-rate offset characterisation
description: Capture accelerometer and gyroscope readings on a stationary board after reflow. Compare against TN0018 expectations to confirm the V1.2 land-pattern fix has eliminated the V1.1 thermomechanical stress.

title: Fast-mode robustness
description: Verify stable communication at 400 kHz. Pass if no I2C NACK errors occur over 1000 consecutive transactions. If failures occur, reduce R3 / R4 from 10 kΩ to 4.7 kΩ on the `esp32_module` sheet (tracked as a V1.3 backlog item on the ESP32 Module page).

title: QR-code URL resolution
description: Validated on the V1.2 boards in service.

title: Compliance-mark legibility
description: Validated; marks survive open-deck installation.

title: Pick-and-place fiducial recognition
description: Validated through V1.2 production assembly.

title: Output voltage accuracy
description: Measure VCC at TP1 with no Wi-Fi activity. Pass if 3.30 V ± 2 % (3.234–3.366 V).

title: Input current at Wi-Fi TX
description: Measure VSD-side current at U2 VIN during a sustained 802.11b TX burst (11 Mbps). Pass if mean current is within 130–170 mA at VSD = 12 V.

title: U2 IC temperature at sustained Wi-Fi TX
description: Run continuous 802.11b TX for 10 min at 85 °C enclosure ambient. Pass if U2 case temperature stays below ~95 °C (Tj ≈ 111 °C internal).

title: Output ripple at Wi-Fi TX burst
description: Probe VCC at TP1 with a 100 MHz scope (low-inductance ground, ≤ 5 mm tip-to-tip), sustained 802.11b TX. Pass if peak-to-peak ripple at the 400 kHz fundamental is below 50 mV.

title: L1 thermal at sustained load
description: Touch-probe L1 case after 10 min of continuous Wi-Fi TX at 85 °C ambient. Pass if case is below ~80 °C.

title: SW-node snubber decision
description: Probe SW with a 500 MHz scope (low-inductance ground spring). Pass without snubber if peak ringing is < ~1 V above V_in; otherwise populate R13 + C10.

title: VCC vs 3v3 SMPS output, at Wi-Fi TX
description: Probe both sides of FB1 simultaneously during a Wi-Fi TX burst. Pass if the digital VCC side shows visibly reduced HF ripple compared with the SMPS-output side.

title: End-to-end programming via ESP-PROG
description: Flash a known firmware image at 921600 baud over the standard ESP-PROG adapter and cable. Pass if the image flashes cleanly, the device boots, and Wi-Fi associates. (Confirmed working on WTI400 V1.2 and MDD400 V2.9.)
result: Confirmed working on WTI400 V1.2 and MDD400 V2.9

title: D4 back-feed check
description: Power the board from its own SMPS only, with the programmer disconnected. Probe J1 pin 2 (V_PROG). Pass if pin 2 measures < 0.1 V (any voltage above this indicates leakage through D4 or contamination).

title: U4 thermal soak during programming
description: Hold the SoC in ROM download mode while the programmer drives sustained UART traffic for 60 s. Probe U4 body temperature with a contact thermocouple and record peak. Pass if peak ≤ 95 °C in a 70 °C ambient (≥ 30 °C Tj margin).

title: Pogo-pin fixture programming
description: Once the pogo-pin fixture exists, verify end-to-end flashing through it using the board's own VCC for the programming session. Confirm no contamination, no over-stress, and matching pinout to the J1 THT pad footprint.

title: WIND_8V rail at J5 under load
description: Measure at the connector tab at JP1 8v4, transducer connected and rotating. Expected 8.30 V at 25 mA. Repeat at JP1 6v8 → expected 6.54 V at 25 mA.

title: VAS rail voltage
description: Confirm 8.65 V (8v4) / 6.89 V (6v8) at the LP2951 output pad under each load condition.

title: LP2951 thermal soak
description: 30 min run at VSC = 14.8 V, JP1 6v8, 30 mA load. Record package temperature. Pass if estimated Tj stays below 110 °C at 40 °C ambient.

title: VSENSE voltage at P HIGH
description: Reed switch open, transducer connected. Expected ~3.0–3.3 V.

title: WND_EN / WND_ERR handshake
description: Verify VAS is off at boot, enables when WND_EN is driven low, asserts WND_ERR low when the cable is disconnected (transducer absent).

title: ADC range characterisation
description: Rotate vane through full 360°, log raw WIND_X / WIND_Y ADC counts. Identify clipping bearings and quantify atan2 reconstruction error. Decision point: if clipping is unacceptable, reduce R50/R51 (Rf) in a V2.0 spin; if acceptable, document the angular error budget for firmware compensation.

title: atan2 zero-angle calibration
description: Hold vane at 0°, 90°, 180°, 270° (referenced to a marked heading). Record firmware-reported angle. Document zero offset and maximum reconstruction error across all four quadrants.

title: Speed pulse PPR calibration
description: Drive anemometer at measured RPM, log WIND_SPD ISR rate, confirm 2 PPR (Raymarine spec), derive firmware calibration constant.

title: Inter-channel crosstalk
description: 1 kHz, 1 V_pk on WIND_X with WIND_Y open. Pass if < 1 LSB of 1 kHz content appears on WIND_Y.

title: R31 pull-down direction
description: R31 currently holds BUTTON LOW during boot, which reads as a button press. A weak pull-up (e.g. 100 kΩ) to VCC would hold BUTTON HIGH (not-pressed = idle) during boot — the correct safe default. Review whether any pull resistor is needed at all given U10's push-pull output. Also eliminates the ~0.33 mA continuous drain that R31 currently causes.

title: D11 sourcing for production
description: Qualify a Littelfuse or STMicro equivalent SM8S36CA for CE / ABYC certification; the current FUXINSEMI part is suitable for prototype but not preferred for production compliance.

title: L2 / L3 body spacing
description: Current edge-to-edge gap is 1.95 mm — 0.05 mm short of the 2 mm keepout. Increase in next layout revision.

title: OVP threshold margin at temperature
description: At 85 °C the OVP threshold reaches 15.1 V — only 300 mV above the 14.8 V NMEA 2000 maximum. Either raise the 25 °C trip point (decrease R28 or increase R27) or replace the divider-only comparator with a voltage reference for temperature-stable operation.

title: Over-temperature disconnect
description: Add a 2-component mod: a normally-closed thermal switch in series between R26 and GNDREF plus a 100 kΩ pull-up from Q2's gate to source. Switch placement must be adjacent to the hottest component (Q2 or L2 / L3).

title: C29 population decision
description: Resolve DNP status after EMC testing; either populate or remove the footprint.

title: NMEA 2000 certification
description: The physical layer meets ISO 11898-2, but formal NMEA 2000 certification has not been pursued. Required before any commercial release.

title: Relocate C18 / C19
description: Move C18 / C19 adjacent to U5 pin 3 to reduce VCC bypass trace from ~2.5 mm to ≤ 0.5 mm, per the SN65HVD234 datasheet.

title: TWAI_TX damping footprint
description: No series resistor is fitted on TXD. Add a DNP 0603 footprint to allow evaluation at bring-up without a board respin.

title: Reduce I2C pull-ups for Fast-mode capability
description: If firmware needs 400 kHz I2C, drop R3 / R4 to 4.7 kΩ to widen the C<sub>bus</sub> margin from 35 pF up to ~75 pF.

title: Shorten the ESP_EN routing
description: V1.2 has a 57.1 mm ESP_EN trace from J1 through R9 / C7 to U3 pad 3 (EN). The signal is RC-limited and the trace is acceptable as-is, but the route picks up board noise before the SoC is active. Re-route R9 / C7 closer to U3's EN pad to bring the trace below the 50 mm guideline.

title: R10 and R11 correction
description: R11 must change from 220 Ω to 1 kΩ and R10 from 220 Ω to 270 Ω before the next fabrication run. Rework existing prototypes by hand and verify brightness balance at bring-up.

title: R12 (red) balance review
description: With R11 corrected to 1 kΩ, re-verify red vs green / blue balance and adjust R12 if needed.

title: Verify Vf at operating point
description: The resistor calculations use Vf estimated from the V-A curve at low current. Measure actual Vf at operating current on the reworked prototype and refine resistor values if predicted balance is not achieved.

title: C23 bypass distance
description: Add a dedicated 100 nF 0603 bypass adjacent to U6 pin 6 (currently 9.4 mm away).

title: C47 rework: 2.2 nF → 820 pF
description: Update the schematic BOM and rework all assembled V1.2 units. Component value change only (0603 C0G footprint unchanged). Restores rise-time-assist effectiveness at 4800 baud on long cables and adds 9600 baud capability.

title: C49 / C50 schematic part-number fix
description: KiCAD schematic lists the wrong manufacturer P/N (GRM188R71H104KA93D, 100 nF) for C49 / C50; assembled BOM value (100 pF) is correct. Metadata-only fix in the schematic.

title: C58 and C54 bypass distance
description: C58 is 7.70 mm from U14 VIN; C54 is 5.46 mm from U14 VOUT. Both exceed the ≤ 2 mm guideline. If VST oscillation is observed under transient load at bring-up, rework both caps to within 2 mm of U14 pins.

title: D8 proximity
description: Relocate D8 to within 3 mm of the ST_SIG isolation via for better transient suppression (currently 10.7 mm).

title: Dedicated VCC bypass at U7
description: Add a 100 nF 0603 adjacent to U7 VCC pin (pin 6).

title: Guard ring around U6 isolation gap
description: Add an unconnected guard trace if conformal coating is not applied; reduces ionic creepage risk in marine salt-spray.

title: HS NMEA 0183 TX support
description: Robust 38400 baud TX requires a redesigned rise-time-assist stage (e.g. constant-current source) — not achievable with a simple C47 value change.

title: PCB creepage slot
description: Evaluate adding a milled slot at the U7 / U8 isolation boundary if CE / MED certification is pursued.

title: Replace J3 with M12 3-pin waterproof connector
description: M12 A-code or B-code, panel-mount, IP67, field-wireable; the SeaTalk I pin assignment (power / ground / signal) maps directly.

title: Interrupt routing for algorithm timing
description: INT1 and INT2 are currently unconnected. If the compensation algorithm requires precise interrupt-driven sample timing, route INT1 to a spare ESP32 GPIO in the next PCB revision.

title: ODR adequacy for velocity algorithm
description: Once the masthead-velocity compensation algorithm is designed, verify that 52 Hz provides sufficient temporal resolution for accurate integration. The LSM6DSL supports ODR up to 6664 Hz; increasing requires only a firmware register change.

title: Compliance test reports
description: The CE, UKCA, and FCC marks on the silkscreen indicate the device is designed for compliance with the corresponding standards. The actual *test reports* that authorise affixing those marks are part of the V1.3 compliance pre-screening campaign (CISPR 32 conducted emissions, FCC Part 15 radiated, RED 2014/53/EU harmonised standards, NMEA 2000 conformance). The marks should not be affixed on production boards until the test reports are signed off.

title: Copyright year update
description: Refresh S8 to the V1.3 production year if it differs from 2025.

title: Re-scan QR code URL
description: Confirm the deployed URL still matches the silkscreen QR on the V1.3 PCB before fabrication.

title: Switch L1 to production BOM
description: Move from Fenghua FNR5040S220MT (prototype stock) to Bourns SRN5040TA-220M (production); same footprint, ~+0.4–0.5 % efficiency improvement and a guaranteed SRF spec.

title: Switch U2 to LMR51610XDRGR (DRG package, exposed pad)
description: If higher MCU or peripheral current budgets are anticipated. DRG θJA = 48 °C/W vs DBV's 148 °C/W gives ~18 °C of additional thermal headroom at the same dissipation.

title: Shorten the ESP_EN routing
description: V1.2 has a 57.1 mm ESP_EN trace from J1 through R9 / C7 to U3 pad 3 (EN). Re-route R9 / C7 closer to U3's EN pad to bring the trace below the 50 mm guideline. (Also tracked on the ESP32 Module page.)

title: Re-prioritise the F.Cu GND_WIND zone to priority 16
description: Currently 15, same as GNDREF unnamed fill, so domain separation is enforced by zone priority rather than the clearance rule alone.

title: Tie R48 (and R53 mirror) to WIND_8V instead of VCC
description: Rescale R47/R48 so V_bias tracks the JP1 setpoint. Centres V_out at the ADC mid-range at *both* setpoints, enabling B&G 213 (and similar 6.5 V Hall-bias transducers) on the same hardware.
